description_en: Queries the specification information of a WAF instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-instance-spec-info --instance-id waf-cn-st2225l0000 --resource-group-id rg-atstuj3rtop0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceSpecInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the WAF instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp in the format of milliseconds.

For instances that use the pay-as-you-go billing method, the returned value indicates the expiration time of the trial edition
ExpireTime.description_zh:
WAF实例的到期时间。格式为毫秒级时间戳。

对于按量计费实例，返回的值表示试用版的到期时间

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the WAF instance

InstanceSpecInfos.description_en: The specification information of the WAF instance. The information is returned as an array of Code and Value pairs. Code indicates the specification code, and Value indicates the corresponding specification value
InstanceSpecInfos.description_zh: WAF实例的规格信息，以Code与Value的数组形式返回实例的各项规格信息。其中，Code表示规格代码，Value表示对应的规格值

Code.description_en:
The specification code of the WAF instance. Valid values:

100: indicates whether HTTPS service protection is supported.
101: the daily service traffic threshold.
102: the mitigation threshold for HTTP flood attacks.
103: the total number of domain names that can be added for protection.
104: indicates whether wildcard domain names are supported.
105: the number of custom mitigation policies (ACL access control) rules that can be configured.
106: the number of back-to-origin IP addresses for domain names.
107: indicates whether servers outside Alibaba Cloud are supported.
108: indicates whether the custom advanced web access control feature is supported.
109: indicates whether non-standard ports are supported.
110: indicates whether the scan protection feature is supported.
111: indicates whether data risk control is supported.
112: the number of data risk control records that can be configured.
113: the number of primary domain names (top-level domain names) that can be added for protection.
114: the normal service bandwidth threshold.
115: the number of attached domain name packages.
116: indicates whether adding ECS IP addresses under different Alibaba Cloud accounts as origin server IP addresses is supported.
117: indicates whether adding Web Hosting IP addresses as origin server IP addresses is supported.
118: the number of data risk control rule scenarios that can be configured.
119: indicates whether the semantics analysis DPI engine feature is supported.
12: indicates whether the service network traffic analysis feature is supported.
120: indicates whether ICP filing verification is required for domain names added for protection.
121: indicates whether custom mitigation policies (HTTP flood attack prevention) rules can be configured.
122: the number of custom mitigation policies (HTTP flood attack prevention) rules that can be configured.
123: indicates whether the region-level IP blacklist feature is supported.
124: indicates whether web tamper-proofing is supported.
125: the number of custom tamper-proofing protection rules that can be configured.
126: indicates whether log collection is supported.
127: the number of non-standard ports that can be added.
128: the HTTP protocol ports that can be added.
129: the HTTPS protocol ports that can be added.
13: indicates whether switching the HTTP flood protection mode is supported.
130: indicates whether attacker profiling is supported.
131: indicates whether the sensitive information leak prevention feature is supported.
132: the number of sensitive information leak prevention rules that can be configured.
133: the condition fields that can be used in custom mitigation policies and whitelist policies.
134: the number of attached exclusive IP addresses.
135: indicates whether the data dashboard feature is supported.
136: the number of supported data dashboards.
137: indicates whether the deep learning engine feature is supported.
138: indicates whether full logs are supported.
139: the storage duration of full logs.
14: indicates whether viewing HTTP flood attack log details is supported.
140: the maximum storage capacity of full logs.
141: indicates whether the alerting settings feature is supported.
142: the number of times the full log storage space can be cleared.
143: indicates whether custom protection rule groups are supported.
144: the number of custom rule groups that can be configured.
145: indicates whether the general gateway proxy for protection modules is supported.
146: indicates whether the general rule proxy for protection modules is supported.
147: indicates whether the security expert service platform is supported.
148: indicates whether trial use is supported.
149: indicates whether transparent proxy mode is supported.
150: indicates whether IPv6 is supported.
151: indicates whether the proactive defense feature is supported.
152: the number of proactive defense rules that can be configured.
153: indicates whether HTTP 2.0 service protection is supported.
154: indicates whether the domain name configuration feature is supported.
155: indicates whether the asset discovery feature is supported.
156: indicates whether pre-release testing specifications are available.
157: indicates whether virtual exclusive clusters are supported.
158: the number of ports supported by virtual exclusive clusters.
159: indicates whether the account security feature is supported.
160: the number of interfaces for account security protection.
162: the number of whitelist rules that can be added.
163: the number of custom protection rules.
164: the number of IP blacklist rules.
167: indicates whether custom scan protection configuration is supported.
168: the number of Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) protected domain names.
169: indicates whether intelligent load balancing is supported.
171: indicates whether the application protection feature is supported.
172: the number of application protection rules.
173: indicates whether the typical crawler behavior identification feature is supported.
176: indicates whether the legitimate crawler identification feature is supported.
177: indicates whether the crawler threat intelligence feature is supported.
181: the number of traffic redirection configurations (each corresponding to a specific instance IP address and port) that can be added for transparent access.
190: indicates whether HTTP flood attack prevention capabilities are supported.
191: indicates whether account security defense capabilities are supported.
192: indicates whether scan attack prevention capabilities are supported.
193: indicates whether custom TLS security policy is supported.
194: indicates whether advanced settings for custom TLS security policy are supported.
196: indicates whether transparent access supports attaching any interface.
199: indicates whether origin fetch over IPv6 is supported.
200: indicates whether scenario-specific anti-crawler configuration is supported.
201: the number of scenario-specific anti-crawler configurations

Value.description_en:
The value that corresponds to the WAF instance specification code. The value can be true (yes) or false (no), or a specific number.

For example, if Code is set to 103, the Value is 640. If Code is set to 104, the Value is true
Value.description_zh:
WAF实例规格代码对应的值。取值可以为true（表示是）或false（表示否）；也可以为具体的数值。

例如，如果Code取值为103，则Value取值为640；如果Code取值为104，则Value取值为true

Version.description_en:
The version of the WAF instance. Valid values:

<props="china">

version_3: Premium Edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_4: Business edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_5: Ultimate Edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_exclusive_cluster: virtual exclusive cluster edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_hybrid_clou_standard: hybrid cloud WAF edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_pro_asia: Premium Edition outside China.

version_business_asia: Business edition outside China.

version_enterprise_asia: Ultimate Edition outside China.

version_exclusive_cluster_asia: virtual exclusive cluster edition outside China.

version_hybrid_cloud_standard_asia: hybrid cloud WAF edition outside China.

version_elastic_bill: pay-as-you-go billing method edition.

version_elastic_bill_new: pay-as-you-go billing method 2.0 edition.

</props>

<props="intl">

version_pro_china: Premium Edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_business_china: Business edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_enterprise_china: Ultimate Edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_exclusive_china: virtual exclusive cluster edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_hybrid_cloud_standard_china: hybrid cloud WAF edition in the Chinese mainland.

version_pro: Premium Edition outside China.

version_business: Business edition outside China.

version_enterprise: Ultimate Edition outside China.

version_exclusive: virtual exclusive cluster edition outside China.

version_hybrid_cloud_standard: hybrid cloud WAF edition outside China.

</props>

<props="china">If the returned version parameter value is not in the preceding list, confirm that you are using an Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com) account.</props>

<props="intl">If the returned version parameter value is not in the preceding list, confirm that you are using an Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com) account.</props>
